examples.arabic: في السوق، شافوا فواكه وخضروات بألوان كتير جميلة.
examples.english: In the market, they saw many fruits and vegetables with beautiful colors.
examples.transliteration: Fel soo2, shafou fawakeh we khodarwat be alwan ketir gamila.

examples.arabic: بعد ما نرجع البيت، هعمل سلطات فواكه متنوعة وهاشرب فنجان قهوة تاني مع صحباتي وهنتبسط أوي.
examples.english: After we return home, I will make various fruit salads and will drink another cup of coffee with my female friends, and we will enjoy ourselves very much.
examples.transliteration: Baʾd ma nergaʾ el beyt, haʾamel salatat fawakih metnawwaʾa w hashrah fangaan ʾahwa tany maʾa soḥabaty w hanetbaset ʾawy.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: السوق كبير ومليان فواكه وخضروات جميلة
examples.english: The market is big and full of beautiful fruits and vegetables.
examples.transliteration: El souq kabeer w malyan fawakeh w khadrawat gameela.

examples.english: I want to buy fruits and vegetables.
